prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1 is the current chart icon; image 2 is its original spacecraft photo, used for authentic shape and terrain reference. Phoebe: complete its almost spherical, subtly irregular body where the current cutout has lost the dark hemisphere. Preserve recognizable large crater locations. Soft opaque dark lower-right terrain, not a crescent or missing side. Keep the orientation of image 1. Preserve observed proportions and recognizable surface features, infer hidden terrain conservatively only to complete the body. Relight with a soft key coming from NORTHWEST / upper LEFT of the image, brightest upper-left and softly shaded lower-right, with enough fill to read the opaque dark side. Do not copy the original photo's right-side lighting. High quality realistic museum specimen rendering, crisp fine craters without inventing flamboyant terrain. Single isolated complete body centered, 93–95% square occupancy, genuine transparent background. No ground, no cast shadow, no stars, no text, no glow. The entire body including shadowed terrain must remain opaque. Correct this draft's silhouette: Phoebe is nearly round, not a jagged egg with mountain peaks. Fill the large V notch at the top into a softly curved rounded lunar limb, keep minor crater rim irregularity only. Preserve the cratered face and NW lighting.
note: Photo-constrained reconstruction; unlit surface detail is inferred, not observed.

provenance.description: AI reconstruction from a mission photograph and its cutout. Missing dark terrain and fine detail are inferred.
